scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:billing && pnpm run test:sync
scripts.test:api: cd services/api-gateway && python -m pytest -q tests/test_auth_dependencies.py tests/test_payroll_calculations.py tests/test_patients.py tests/test_finance_engine.py tests/test_finance_reports.py tests/test_payroll_engine.py
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run lint:go
scripts.lint:api: cd services/api-gateway && python -m ruff check app/auth/dependencies.py app/auth/keycloak.py app/config.py app/database.py app/main.py app/middleware/facility_context.py tests/conftest.py tests/test_auth_dependencies.py
scripts.lint:api:full: cd services/api-gateway && python -m ruff check . && python -m ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:go: cd services/billing-service && go vet ./... && cd ../sync-service && go vet ./...
scripts.typecheck:full: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:api
